## Comments

Comments start with `REM` and continue to the end of the line.

Example:

```text
REM This is a comment
```

Multiline comments start with `REM` on each line and continue to the end of the line.

Example:

```text
REM This is a multiline comment
REM It spans multiple lines
```

## Setting a variable

Variables are set using the `Dude, mark` phrase followed by the variable name and its value.

Example:

```text
Dude, mark n 0;
```

## Syntax

```text
REM Declare an integer (n), and a string constant (s)

Dude, say what you want about n, at least it's an integer

Dude, fucking s, nothing changes, fucking “I am the walrus”
```

```bash
REM Set n

Dude, mark n 0;
```

```bash
REM Some logic

Dude, is s “I am the walrus”
{
    Smokey, n is not 0, n is 1
}

Duderino, is s “He fixes the cable”
{
    Is n = 0 Walter?
    : No Donny, is n is
    : Shut the fuck up, D
}

Thats like your opinion man
{
    Fuck it lets go bowling;
}
```
